headline: Brazilian agribusiness faces credit crunch as LCA concessions drop 40%
summary: Concessions from free LCA (Agribusiness Credit Letters) fell 40% in one year. Industry experts warn that tighter subsidized credit will make agricultural financing costlier under current government policies.
why: Brazil is the world's leading exporter of soybeans, sugar, and poultry. Changes to sector financing mechanisms alter working capital costs for major agricultural producers.
